messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem today 11 on the routing oscillation during the cert-rotation window. Need concrete owners/timelines and a safe rollout plan.

alex: Short problem recap: when cert rotation overlapped with a transient egress reset, a subset of LB replicas fell back to a legacy route due to routing-precedence bug, which caused a retry storm. Root causes: race in route-install vs cert-activation + permissive SNI fallback logic.

maria: I can take the immediate mitigation: add conservative backoff on route-change notifications and force a config reconciliation hook. Plan: small patch + fast rollback path. ETA: tomorrow morning.

sam: I'll take the LB behavior change to make fallback explicit rather than silent. That'll be an opt-in flag initially. PR target: Fri EOD. Need @infra review for schema change.

leo: I'll own the reproducible test harness for the race. Will script an integration job that runs cert-rotate + simulated egress flaps and asserts no route fallback. ETA: Thu noon.

natalie: Monitoring owner here. I'll add a retry amplification alert: (retries_per_min > 100 with pct_origin_fallback > 5%) -> P1. Also adding a dashboard panel showing cert-rotation events vs retry spikes. ETA: tomorrow afternoon.

infra-bot: Incident REM-2026-058 created. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/pm/REM-2026-058. Scheduled reminder: @sam in 2 days.

alex: Deployment constraints: changing fallback behavior is a behavioral change; do canary at 5% for 30m with synthetic probe that triggers cert-rotation scenario. If probe fails, auto rollback.

maria: For immediate mitigation I've pushed branch `git@repo:redwood/infra#route-reconcile-fix`. It exposes admin endpoint: POST /admin/force-reconcile?route=*. Example curl: 

```
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" https://admin-infra.redwood/internal/admin/force-reconcile?route=api-*
```

maria: This endpoint will be enabled for next hotfix window and then removed once we have full rollout.

sam: Note: making fallback explicit requires adding `fallback_policy` enum to LB config. I'll add migration docs and a plan to default to `allow` and opt-in `reject` for sensitive customers.

leo: Test harness plan: use perf-ci job that spins two AZs, triggers cert rotation, injects TCP RSTs on egress path, and validates route table remains stable. Will tag job `ci/routing-race`.

natalie: Runbook update: first responder should check `edge-routing:fallback` logs and cert-rotation timestamps. If fallback_count > 50 in 10m and cert-rotate overlaps, escalate to network and infra. Adding sample query for logs: 

```
jsonPayload.event = \"route_fallback\" AND timestamp >= now()-10m
| stats count() by region, origin
```

alex: Two policy decisions to lock down: (1) default `fallback_policy` value, (2) whether the reconcile endpoint is enabled by default for all tenants. Vote?

maria: I vote default `allow` to preserve safety, but enable reconcile endpoint for SREs only. We'll flip default once tests + telemetry are clean.

sam: Agree. Opt-in `reject` makes sense until we have broad compatibility.

alex: Decision recorded: default = `allow`; reconcile endpoint SRE-only; opt-in `reject` per-customer. Update postmortem doc accordingly.

maria: Quick note: the fast rollback will be `kubectl annotate deployment lb-canary rollback=true` which infra can run automatically if canary probe fails. Adding this to the PR.

sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/lb-config/pulls/412. Please review.

leo: Added initial harness PR: https://git.redwood/perf/ci/pulls/88. Needs perms to run.

natalie: Dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/cert-rotate-retries. Linking to postmortem.

alex: Owners recap + timelines: maria: reconcile endpoint + hotfix (tomorrow AM); sam: fallback_policy + PR (Fri EOD); leo: harness (Thu noon); natalie: alert + dashboard (tomorrow PM).

alex: Also proposing a monthly "networking incident patterns" sync to track recurrence and trends. Who wants to join?

leo: I'll take co-chair with @maria.

maria: happy to co-chair.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly check-in Tue 10:00 until REM-2026-058 is closed. Assigned: @alex @maria @sam @leo @natalie.

alex: Thanks all. Please update REM-2026-058 action items with PR links and change state to \"In Progress\" when you start. I'll follow up in 24h for a rollup. :thumbsup:
